Claim 1 (Original): An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP __that is not disclosed in Maxell Corp. of America__.

Claim 2 (Original): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath __the bottom of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards.

Claim 4 (Original): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

Claim 5 (Original): The assembly claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

Claim 13 (Original): A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes.

Claim 14 (Original): The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20 C or less.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising __heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to embed the MTP within the plastic__.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP; __positioning the test tube assembly in a reader; and__ reading the MTP.

Claim 17 (Original): The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

Claim 18 (Original): The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20 C or less.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the polypropylene or acetal polymer is capable of withstanding temperatures of -20°C or lower__.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

Claim 21 (Currently Amended): The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath __the bottom of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards.
